name: Chenaanah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy

points: Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah makes horns of iron and says, thus saith the Lord, with these shalt thou push the Syrians until thou have consumed them. Here again a man claims to speak for the Most High while the whole company presses Ahab to go up and prosper.

note.label: 1 Kings 22: A Lying Spirit and the Fall of Ahab

points: Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah smites Micaiah on the cheek and asks which way the spirit of the Lord went from him to speak to Micaiah, defending his own false prophecy. The king of Israel orders Micaiah taken back and put in prison, fed with bread and water of affliction until Ahab returns in peace.

note.label: 1 Kings 22: A Lying Spirit and the Fall of Ahab
